made clear.

Every number on this page was computed, not generated

Three outputs. One transparent calculation path.

The moving signals in the hero correspond to the same deterministic outputs below. This is a demonstration patient, not a generated report.

Signal 01

CKD-EPI 2021 eGFR

The race-free equation the NKF and labs report today. Age, sex, and one creatinine.

43.6 mL/min/1.73m²

58y female, Scr 1.4 mg/dL

Signal 02

KFRE risk

Tangri's 4-variable kidney failure risk, shown as a two-year and five-year probability.

0.9% / 3.3%

2-year / 5-year risk · uACR 180 mg/g

Signal 03

KDIGO staging

The G1–G5 × A1–A3 heat map that turns the same values into clinical risk context.

G3b A2 · Very high risk

Derived from the same values above

Computation, made inspectable

The answer is not a black box.

Nephro turns a small set of clinical values into a citeable assessment. The route from input to guidance is visible at every step.

Inspect the published methods→

Interactive signal field

Three inputs, one traceable assessment.

Explore
01

Start with the patient

Enter age, sex, serum creatinine, and uACR. The tool labels every input and its unit.

02

Run published equations

CKD-EPI 2021 and KFRE are calculated from their published constants, not estimated by a model.

03

Stage the context

KDIGO combines GFR and albuminuria into a prognosis grid with the active cell highlighted.

04

Show the working

Every result can be traced to its inputs, intermediate values, source equation, and guidance rule.

Transparent by design

No black boxes. Every intermediate value visible.

This tool runs the exact published equations nephrologists rely on, shows the inputs and classification logic behind each result, and cites the source for every calculation family. The same inputs produce the same result on every device.

Read the methods
Deterministic, alwaysVerified
  • ✓Confirm chronicity: repeat eGFR and uACR at >=3 months before diagnosing CKD.
  • ✓ACE inhibitor or ARB titrated to the maximum tolerated dose (KDIGO 2024).
  • ✓Monitor at least three times yearly; nephrology referral indicated.
  • ✓Recheck uACR after treatment changes; a sustained doubling of ACR warrants re-evaluation.
  • ✓Avoid NSAIDs; review and renally dose all medications.
  • ✓Guidance is generated from guideline rules, not a language model.
scr 1.4 mg/dL · age 58 · female → eGFR 43.6 · G3b A2 · KFRE 2yr 0.9%

Ready when you are

Run it on a real patient, right now.

Two minutes of lab values in — a complete, citeable CKD assessment out.

Open calculatorView patient records

Not a medical device. This tool implements published equations exactly as specified and shows its working. It does not diagnose, and it does not replace clinical judgement. Every result must be interpreted by a qualified clinician in the context of the individual patient.
